title: Seasonal precipitation climatology
caption: Spatial distribution of seasonal mean precipitation over the Kainji contributing catchment (CHIRPS v2.0): (a) DJF, (b) MAM, (c) JJA and (d) SON, 1981-2025.

title: Annual precipitation time series
caption: Annual mean precipitation (bars) and 5-year moving average (line) for (a) the Kainji contributing catchment, (b) Upper Niger (Guinea Highlands), (c) Middle Niger (Sahel Zone) and (d) Lower Niger (near Kainji Dam), 1981-2025.

title: SPI-12 drought index
caption: 12-month Standardised Precipitation Index (SPI-12) for (a) the whole catchment, (b) Upper Niger, (c) Middle Niger and (d) Lower Niger, 1981-2025. Horizontal dashed lines mark the drought thresholds (-1.0, -1.5, -2.0); drought periods (SPI < -1.0) are shaded red and wet periods (SPI > 1.0) blue.

title: Annual mean precipitation: CHIRPS vs CMIP6
caption: Spatial distribution of annual mean precipitation (mm/month), 1981-2014: (a) CHIRPS, (b) ensemble mean of the ten CMIP6 models and (c)-(l) the individual models.

title: Mean monthly precipitation
caption: Mean monthly precipitation, 1981-2014, for (a) the whole catchment, (b) Upper Niger, (c) Middle Niger and (d) Lower Niger: CHIRPS and the ten CMIP6 models.

title: Taylor diagram
caption: Taylor diagram comparing the ten CMIP6 models and their ensemble mean with CHIRPS over the Kainji contributing catchment, 1981-2014.

title: Projected precipitation change maps
caption: Historical mean (1984-2014), future mean and percentage change in mean monthly precipitation over the Kainji contributing catchment, ten NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 models: SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5, mid-century (2030-2060) and late-century (2070-2100). Stippling marks grid cells with a statistically significant change (Welch's t-test, p < 0.05). Each file (fig4_07a-d) shows one scenario and period, in the order SSP2-4.5 mid-century, SSP2-4.5 late-century, SSP5-8.5 mid-century, SSP5-8.5 late-century; within each file (a) is the historical mean, (b) the future mean and (c) the percentage change.

title: Annual precipitation change, 1981-2100
caption: Annual precipitation change (%) relative to the 1984-2014 model baseline for (a) the whole catchment and (b)-(d) three sub-regions, 1981-2014 and 2026-2100. Solid line: ten-model ensemble mean; dashed line: linear trend; shaded envelope: ensemble min-max spread. Grey bands mark mid-century (2030-2060) and late-century (2070-2100).

title: HMF-WA vs observed seasonal flow
caption: Mean monthly flow at Kainji Dam, 1984-2014: ensemble mean and range of the five HMF-WA GCMs (blue) and observed mean turbine discharge (red, 739.5 m3/s).
source_data: HMF-WA (5 GCMs); observed turbine discharge, Kainji Dam

title: Future seasonal cycle of flow and precipitation
caption: Mean seasonal cycle of the ensemble-mean simulated river flow at Kainji Dam (HMF-WA, above) and of catchment precipitation (NEX-GDDP-CMIP6, below) for the historical period (1984-2014) and for mid-century (2030-2060; a, b) and late-century (2070-2100; c, d) under SSP2-4.5 (a, c) and SSP5-8.5 (b, d). Triangles mark the historical monthly precipitation.

title: HMF-WA historical mean flow map
caption: HMF-WA simulated annual mean river flow (m3/s) within the Kainji contributing catchment, ensemble mean of the five GCMs, 1980-2014.

title: HMF-WA annual flow at Kainji, 1980-2014
caption: Annual mean flow at the Kainji Dam grid cell simulated by HMF-WA for each GCM and their ensemble mean, 1980-2014, with the observed mean turbine discharge (739.5 m3/s).

title: Flow change map, SSP2-4.5
caption: Ensemble-mean percentage change in HMF-WA annual mean flow relative to 1984-2014 under SSP2-4.5 for mid-century (2030-2060, left) and late-century (2070-2100, right). Crosses mark river points where fewer than four of the five GCMs agree on the sign of the change. The triangle marks Kainji Dam.

title: Flow change map, SSP5-8.5
caption: As Figure 4.13 for SSP5-8.5: ensemble-mean percentage change in HMF-WA annual mean flow relative to 1984-2014 for mid-century (2030-2060, left) and late-century (2070-2100, right). Crosses mark river points where fewer than four of the five GCMs agree on the sign of the change.

title: Projected turbine discharge by GCM
caption: Projected turbine discharge at Kainji Dam by GCM and scenario, from the HMF-WA change in annual-mean river flow applied to the baseline discharge of 739.51 m3/s. Black-outlined bars: ensemble mean of the five GCMs; dashed line: baseline mean discharge.

title: Projected turbine discharge, 2015-2100
caption: Projected turbine discharge at Kainji Dam, 2015-2100, under SSP2-4.5 (blue) and SSP5-8.5 (red), from the HMF-WA annual-mean flow change applied to the baseline discharge of 739.51 m3/s. Solid line: ensemble mean; dashed line: Sen trend; shaded envelope: range across the five GCMs; right axis: change relative to baseline.

title: Projected hydropower potential and surplus
caption: (a) Projected hydropower potential (MW) at the mean net head of 37.5 m and (b) surplus or shortfall relative to the baseline potential, for the annual-mean driver. Bars: ensemble mean; whiskers: range across the five GCMs; diamonds: GCM median. Reference lines in (a): baseline potential (237 MW), firm-power threshold (292.44 MW, the 2014 minimum) and installed capacity (760 MW).
source_data: HMF-WA; observed turbine discharge; hydraulic power equation

title: Scenario matrix of hydropower potential
caption: Scenario matrix of hydropower potential (MW) as a function of the change in annual-mean precipitation and net head (33-42 m), with the equivalent flow change from the fitted HMF-WA relation on the upper axis. Contours mark 200, 292.44 (firm power), 400, 500, 600 and 760 MW (installed capacity); markers show the five GCMs and their ensemble mean for each scenario and period.
source_data: Hydraulic power equation; HMF-WA / NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 link

title: Seasonal precipitation: CHIRPS, model ensemble and bias
caption: Spatial distribution of seasonal mean precipitation over the Kainji contributing catchment, 1984-2014. First row: CHIRPS; second row: CMIP6 model ensemble; third row: bias (model minus CHIRPS). Stippling marks grid cells where the difference from CHIRPS is statistically significant (Welch's t-test, p < 0.05). Columns: (a, e, i) DJF, (b, f, j) MAM, (c, g, k) JJA and (d, h, l) SON.

title: Projected precipitation change by model and scenario
caption: Projected precipitation change (%) over the Kainji contributing catchment by CMIP6 model and scenario for (a) the dry season (November-March), (b) the wet season (April-October) and (c) the annual mean, relative to 1984-2014. Black-outlined bars: ten-model ensemble mean.

title: HMF-WA annual flow, 1950-2100
caption: Historical (1950-2014) and projected (2015-2100) annual mean river flow at Kainji Dam simulated by HMF-WA: ensemble mean and range across the five GCMs under SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5. The dashed horizontal line is the observed mean turbine discharge (739.5 m3/s).

title: Projected turbine discharge by driver
caption: Projected turbine discharge at Kainji Dam by GCM and scenario for the (a) annual-mean, (b) dry-season (November-March) and (c) wet-season (April-October) HMF-WA flow change applied to the corresponding observed baseline discharge. Black-outlined bars: five-GCM ensemble mean; dashed line: baseline discharge of each driver.

title: Projected hydropower potential by driver
caption: Projected hydropower potential (a) and surplus or shortfall relative to the baseline potential (b) for the annual-mean, dry-season and wet-season drivers, at the mean net head of 37.5 m. Bars: ensemble mean; whiskers: range across the five GCMs; diamonds: GCM median. Reference lines in (a): baseline potential (237 MW), firm-power threshold (292.44 MW) and installed capacity (760 MW).
source_data: HMF-WA; observed turbine discharge; hydraulic power equation

title: Flow change against precipitation change
caption: Annual-mean flow change at Kainji (HMF-WA) against annual-mean catchment precipitation change (NEX-GDDP-CMIP6) for the five GCMs, two scenarios and two periods (20 pairs). The line is the least-squares fit (dQ = 5.6 + 2.31 dP) and the grey band its 95% prediction interval.
